interface.name: astrea_background_effect_coverage_manager_v1

description.summary: authenticated analytic refinement for client background blur

interface.description: This private Astrea protocol adds bounded, commit-bound analytic coverage to an ext-background-effect-v1 request. The public blur region remains the work and visibility upper bound. Coordinates are surface-local logical Wayland fixed-point values. This protocol does not change the public background-effect protocol for other clients.

interface.name: astrea_background_effect_coverage_v1

description.summary: commit-bound rounded rectangle and triangle coverage

interface.description: At most one rounded rectangle and one triangle are stored. Their union is evaluated only during final effect composition. Requests are pending until the associated wl_surface commits. clear disables analytic refinement.
